title: Stop sampling after an unexpected request.
comment:
**Stop sampling after an unexpected request.**

If `checkRequest` rejects a look request, this catch records an `invalid` sample and continues because `ledger.blocked` is unset. `run-started.json` requires an unexpected look request to stop the run and leave later samples untaken. Stop after recording this failure, while retaining the partial run for inspection.
